title: Non-Library seg rows clip their labels across ~14 pages
goal: Across roughly fourteen pages the small rows of side-by-side choices squeeze their labels until words are cut off, so you cannot read the options. This gives those rows enough room to show their labels in full.
notes: Browser-measured while verifying the Systems scope rollout: several non-Library .seg rows ellipsize labels (scrollWidth > clientWidth). Worst: brush-library category chips (Sketch:17px, Texture:18px, Custom:19px), paint fill-type seg (Angular:17px), img-masking (Gradient:17px), draw-boolean (Intersect:12px, Subtract:11px), video-speed (Slow-mo:11px), redline (Spacing:13px x2), ui-autolayout (Between:8px), color (Document:4px x3), typography, ui-grid, ui-variants, video-captions, video-motion, draw, brush-editor. Same bug class the .scopeseg fix solved for the Library row (segmented.css natural-width columns + border-compensated padding); these rows likely want .scopeseg geometry or the collapse-to-select treatment. Measure each in the browser before and after.
acceptance: Measured in a browser at the default panel width, no choice label in those rows is cut off
The fix comes from the shared styling for those rows rather than a per-page override
Before and after measurements for the worst offenders are recorded in the task log
